name: Deep South Boat Storage and RV Park
description: Deep South is less than 8 miles to Gulf Shores and only 3 miles to restaurants, OWA water park and Tanger Outlets. We are situated on 18 acres, with 24 RV sites. All sites include full hookup, 30 and 50 amp. along with sewer hookup. Park your RV on spacious cement pads perfect for lawn chairs, personal grills, and relaxing. Sites also include high speed Wi-Fi. For your convenience we offer storage for boats, campers and trailers.
